FX-SMEAR-001.says: The settings as they start: no source mask: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SMEAR-002.says: Source mask 1, a square from (4, 3) to (8, 7), offset three pixels right: the stripes in the square carried right, the drawing's edges held; FX-RESHAPE-002's frame, whose destination is that square moved so.

FX-SMEAR-003.says: The square turned 45 degrees clockwise about its middle: the stripes in it twisted.

FX-SMEAR-004.says: The square scaled to 150 per cent: the middle swollen.

FX-SMEAR-005.says: The square scaled to 50 per cent, turned 90 degrees and offset by (2, 1).

FX-SMEAR-006.says: FX-SMEAR-002 with boundary mask 2, (3, 1) to (13, 9): nothing outside it moves, so columns 0 to 1 and 14 to 15 are the drawing's own.

FX-SMEAR-008.says: FX-SMEAR-003 at Elasticity Liquid: the twist kept near the square's edges.

FX-SMEAR-009.says: Mask Offset keyed from (0, 0) at frame 0 to (3, 0) at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 4 FX-SMEAR-002's.

FX-SMEAR-010.says: FX-SMEAR-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the masks are the layer's, so all of it moves with the layer.

FX-SMEAR-011.says: Percent keyed from 20 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2, the same as frame 4.

FX-SMEAR-012.says: The source's path keyed from the square at frame 0 to two rows lower at frame 4, offset three right: frame 0 FX-SMEAR-002's.

FX-SMEAR-013.says: Percent 0, the square offset: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SMEAR-014.says: Source mask 3, of two. Nothing to smear: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SMEAR-015.says: Source mask 1, switched off. Nothing to smear: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SMEAR-016.says: Boundary mask 3 with two masks. Nothing to smear: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-SMEAR-017.says: Elasticity "rubber", not one of the seven. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-018.says: Mask Scale 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-019.says: Mask Rotation 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-020.says: Mask Offset (10001, 0), its x above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-021.says: Percent keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMEAR-022.says: Source mask -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
